Poem of Gilgameš – Standard Babylonian I: “[He Who Saw The Deep, The] Foundation Of The Country”

Meanings are from the eBL dictionary (largely based on CDA – Black, George & Postgate, A Concise Dictionary of Akkadian). Stem-specific meanings (G, D, Š, N…) follow the main gloss.

-u I

  • Meaning: loc.-adv. suffix cf. GAG §66
  • Lines: 115
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/-u%20I

-ya I

  • Meaning: "my" (1 sg. pron. suff.) (cf. GAG §42g-k)
  • Lines: 244
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/-ya%20I

-šu I

  • Meaning: —
  • Lines: 115
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/-%C5%A1u%20I

abnu I

  • Meaning: m. & f.; pl. abnū and abnātu(m) "stone" [NA4]
  • Logograms: NA4
  • Lines: 34
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abnu%20I

abu I

  • Meaning: "father" (st. constr. abi, occas. abu, ab; nom. with pron. suff. abī, M/NB, NA also abū(y)a; abūšu etc.; pl. abbū, O/MA abbā'ū, MB(Alal.), Am. abbūtu) [AD]
  • Logograms: AD
  • Lines: 66, 83, 120, 121, 132, 144
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abu%20I

abātu I

  • Meaning: "to destroy"
    • G: (a/u, O/jB also i'abbat, i'but (cf. GAG §97h)) objects, buildings; living beings; OA "ruin (economically)"
    • D: "destroy completely" objects, parts of body, living beings; jB occas. + eli instead of acc.
    • Dt: pass. of D [GUL.MEŠ]
    • Š: caus. of G OB(lit.)
    • N: pass. of G (forms cf. GAG §97j)
  • Logograms: GUL.MEŠ
  • Lines: 34
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ab%C4%81tu%20I

abūbu I

  • Meaning: "flood, deluge" Bab. [A.MA.RU]
  • Logograms: A.MA.RU
  • Lines: 8, 43
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ab%C5%ABbu%20I

adi I

  • Meaning: "until, as far as" [EN]
  • Logograms: EN, A.RÁ
  • Lines: 40
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/adi%20I

adānu I

  • Meaning: pl. f. "fixed date, time limit" Bab. (Ass. cf. edānu) [UD.DUG4.GA; U4.SUR] ūm a. "fixed day"; jB ina lā a. "at the wrong time"; astr. "period"; eqel a. "objective"
  • Logograms: UD.DUG4.GA, U4.SUR
  • Lines: 167
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ad%C4%81nu%20I

adāru I

  • Meaning: "to be dark, gloomy"
    • G: (a/u) j/NB [KA≈GI6]; of day; of gods, people; of heavenly bodies "become obscured"; of plants ?
    • D: O/jB "darken", esp. stat. with pānū/ī "look gloomy"
    • Dt: jB, NA "become gloomy"
    • Š: "darken" j/NB, NA
    • N: "become dark"; astr. "become eclipsed" [KA≈GI6] OB, j/NB
    • Ntn: iter. of N jB
  • Logograms: KA≈GI6
  • Lines: 65, 82
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ad%C4%81ru%20I

adāru II

  • Meaning: "to be afraid (of), fear"
    • G: (a/u) NB ēnē a. 'fear the eyes' = "with an eye to, in consideration of"
    • D: "frighten" OA, jB
    • Štn: iter. of Š O/jB
    • Št: pass. of Š
    • N: "become restless, worry about" OA, OB, jB
    • Ntn: iter. of N OA, OB, jB
  • Lines: 116
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ad%C4%81ru%20II

agurru I

  • Meaning: m. & f.
  • Logograms: SIG4.AL.ÙR.RA, SIG4.AL.UR5.RA
  • Lines: 20
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/agurru%20I

agû II

  • Meaning: "wave, flood" Bab. [A.GI6.A; A.GU4; A.GA] of river etc.; transf. ref. to wrath of gods, demons;
  • Logograms: A.GI6.A, A.GU4, A.GA
  • Lines: 34
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ag%C3%BB%20II

ahu I

  • Meaning: "brother" (st. constr. ahi, OA ahu/ū; nom. with pron. suff. ahūni/ka; ahī, ahūa "my brother", M/NB ahūya; acc. ahāka; st. abs. ah OAkk, OA in PN; du. ahā OB; pl. ahhū, W.Sem. ahāte, OB after numerals ahānu; st. constr. ahhī OB all cases; with pron. suff. ahhūka) [ŠEŠ; OB also ŠEŠ.A.NI; PAP in later PNs, NA]
  • Logograms: ŠEŠ, ŠEŠ.A.NI,
  • Lines: 32
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ahu%20I

ai I

  • Meaning: (before consonant), â, ya "not"
  • Lines: 180
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ai%20I

akālu I

  • Meaning: "to eat"
    • G: (a/u) [GU7]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [GU7.GU7]
    • Gt: of lands "ravage each other"; of stars "cover, absorb each other"
    • Š: caus. of G [GU7] "make" men, animals, fire "eat, feed on, consume" food, medication, goods, booty, lands; "steep" an object in liquid; OA "satisfy" a claimant; jB stat. "is infected" with a disease
    • Št: [GU7] OB math. "multiply together", freq. "square" measured lengths N pass. of G [GU7]
  • Logograms: GU7, GU7.GU7
  • Lines: 108, 173
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ak%C4%81lu%20I

alkakātu I

  • Meaning: pl. "ways of life; actions, behaviour" Bab.(lit.) of gods, demons, people;
  • Lines: 2, 4
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/alkak%C4%81tu%20I

alû III

  • Meaning: (a kind of drum) Bab. [GIŠ.Á.LÁ];
  • Logograms: GIŠ.Á.LÁ
  • Lines: 227
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C3%BB%20III

alādu I

  • Meaning: "to give birth (to)" [Ù.TU; occas. TU]
    • G: (a/i)
    • Gtn: iter. of G [Ù.TU.MEŠ]
    • Dt: pass. of D "be begotten"
    • Š: caus. of G
    • N: pass. of G children mala waldū u iwwalladū "as many as are or shall be born"
  • Logograms: Ù.TU, TU, Ù.TU.MEŠ
  • Lines: 47, 221
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81du%20I

alāku I

  • Meaning: "to go"
    • G: (illak, illik; perf. ittalak (cf. GAG §97n)) [DU]
    • Gtn: [DU.DU] "go, come repeatedly; roam about, wander", muttallik mūši [LÚ.GE6.A.DU.DU; (LÚ.)GE6.DU.DU] 'who walks around during the night' = "night-watchman"; OB of leg muscles "twitch persistently"
    • Gt: "go off, away" (cf. GAG §92e) differentiation between pret. of Gt and perf. of G difficult
    • Š: caus. of G [DU] with abstr. noun ending in -ūtu or adv. "make s.o./s.th. (become)" s.th.; stat. "is appropriate, suitable" [TÚM.MA]
  • Logograms: DU, IGI.DU, DU.DU
  • Lines: 9, 18, 28, 31, 32, 61, 119, 121, 124, 133, 138, 145, 148, 151, 160, 165, 198, 207, 214, 224, 241, 266, 289
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81ku%20I

ammatu I

  • Meaning: "forearm; cubit" [KÙŠ]; kiṣir a. "elbow"; as linear measure "cubit", st. abs. ammat [1.KÙŠ]; NB as area measure, also a. ṣehertu "small cubit"; NB as vol. measure a. qaqqari; X ina ammati "X cubits (long)"; a. rabītu "big cubit"; a. šarri "royal cubit"; NB astr. (a measurement of angle); jB transf. "strength"?; lex. "cubitmeasure" of wood?
  • Logograms: KÙŠ
  • Lines: 52, 53, 55, 56
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ammatu%20I

ammīni I

  • Meaning: "why?";
  • Lines: 206
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/amm%C4%ABni%20I

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ
  • Lines: 1, 3, 7, 13, 114, 125, 142, 152, 163, 176, 181, 195, 222, 233, 271, 274, 286, 296
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/am%C4%81ru%20I

ana I

  • Meaning: (aš-š... etc.) "to, for" (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n to following consonant (OA often wr. a)) (prep., governs subst. in gen., pers. pron. in dat.) [from MB onwards DIŠ; O/MB occas. NAM; M/jB ŠÈ]
  • Logograms: DIŠ, NAM, ŠÈ
  • Lines: 16, 42, 43, 44, 45, 66, 70, 74, 83, 89, 95, 119, 120, 127, 131, 132, 133, 140, 142, 144, 147, 154, 158, 159, 161, 163, 168, 181, 194, 204, 207, 208, 208a, 208b, 213, 215, 224, 243, 257, 258, 272, 273, 284, 285, 292, 297
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ana%20I

annû I

  • Meaning: OB occas. with nunation "this, those" [j/NB NE; ŠEŠ (for m. pl. annûti)]; OB f. sg. annītum "this matter"; annītam lā annītam 'this one, not this one', "one way or another"; a. ū a. "various"; NA a(n)nûte ... a(n)nûte ... "some ..., others ..."; (a)kī (h)anni(ma) "thus, in the same way";
  • Logograms: ,
  • Lines: 97, 178
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ann%C3%BB%20I

Anu I

  • Meaning: "An(um)" (the god of heaven) OAkk, Bab. [AN; NB d60]; of Ištar anātima "you are supreme deity";
  • Logograms: AN, NB
  • Lines: 91, 98, 123, 135, 150, 208, 215, 240, 246, 260, 268, 291
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/Anu%20I

anāhu I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) tired"
    • G: (a/a) stat. "becomes tired", "makes an effort, strives"; of buildings etc. "become dilapidated"
    • Gtn: iter. of G jB med., of limbs, person
    • D: OA "tire (s.o.), oppress"
    • Š: Bab. "trouble, exert, strain" s.o.; stat. "is very wearied"
    • Št: "make an effort", "weary o.s., be depressed"; astr. "endure"
    • N: OB "become tired", "struggle, suffer hardship, be exhausted"
  • Lines: 9
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/an%C4%81hu%20I

anāku I

  • Meaning: "I; me" [Bogh. GÁ.E] as pred. freq. anākuma; OB ša anāku "as for me"; NB also acc. (to stress a pron. suff.), dat.
  • Logograms: GÁ.E
  • Lines: 46, 128, 155, 218, 219, 223, 264, 288, 294, 295
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/an%C4%81ku%20I

appūna I

  • Meaning: "moreover" OAkk, OA, O/jB
  • Lines: 274
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/app%C5%ABna%20I

apâtu I

  • Meaning: f. pl. "numerous, teeming", epith. of nišū, also absol., "humanity"
  • Lines: 44
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ap%C3%A2tu%20I

ardatu I

  • Meaning: "girl, young woman" OAkk, Ass., O/jB [(MUNUS.)KI.SIKIL]; ardat lilî (a demoness) (cf. lilium);
  • Logograms: KI.SIKIL MUNUS.KI.SIKIL
  • Lines: 228
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ardatu%20I

arhu II

  • Logograms: ÁB GU4.ÁB
